pages.title: Buttville: The Queen's Lair
pages.text: The Queen's Lair is the end of Earthworm Jim (Shiny Entertainment, 1994), where Jim fights the final boss, Queen Pulsating, Bloated, Festering, Sweaty, Pus-filled, Malformed, Slug-for-a-Butt. VGMPF credits the music to Keith Arem and Mical Pedriana together.

pages.title: The fight
pages.text: To beat the Queen in Earthworm Jim, Jim has to stand on the floating Snott platforms that circle her, and shoot her at the 3, 6, 9 and 12 o'clock positions, or whip her once. Then he meets her sister, Princess Whats-Her-Name, says Sega Retro.
